notes: SHIP v1.14.359 - SHIP-BUILD-BANNER-ROWS. THE MARKUP LANDS. The 12-tile BUILD card grid in #work-grid is replaced by five full-width 2.90:1 banner rows - DEPLOY, SCAN, HANDOFF, MASTER FILE, OPS - and OPS expands IN PLACE into a 3x3 nine-cell tool wall (bom, manifest, portmap, rackmap, sops, burndown, audits, blast, optics), every cell routing to the canonical rd_openOpsTool door. This is the ship .356/.357/.358 were staging assets for; those three changed zero markup, so one device pass over this ship verifies the whole .355-.359 stack. HANDLERS (spec 5): every row reuses the EXACT entry point its 12-tile predecessor used - deploy_quick, showWorkTab('scan'), handoff_quick, rd_openMasterFile, rd_openOpsTool(tab). No new doors invented, 'one door per feature' holds, and no row is a dead tap. OPS is the one row whose tap stays on-screen: new wk_toggleOpsWall(head) toggles .open on the .opsrow host and mirrors aria-expanded, with a loud console.warn + phantomToast if the host cannot be resolved (No-Silent-Failures). ART (spec 2/10): -1170 PHONE rasters only, referenced directly - SCAN, MASTER FILE and OPS carry photographs. NO asset-shell mechanism is introduced; this app has zero picture/srcset/image-set/width-matchMedia/shell-body-class and the one prior dual-raster attempt is dead at repo root, so the desk shell stays a separate future ship with its own mechanism ruling. DEPLOY and HANDOFF ship WITH their rows and handlers but deliberately WITHOUT an img element: their art is HELD (deploy = legible GB300 NVL72 faceplates on a site-agnostic app that runs H100/H200 at AUS-01; handoff = baked UI text asserting a fabricated completed workflow). They render on the section-9.1 fallback instead, so the page structure is complete and every tap works while two rows are VISIBLY incomplete rather than silently broken. SILENT-FAILURE GUARD (spec 9.1): .bnr carries an empty alt and no text, so a row whose raster 404s would otherwise render as a clean empty card that looks deliberate. Every .bnr now has a CSS background fallback - a low-alpha accent hatch in the row's own --rfac - so a missing asset looks WRONG, not empty. All five banner rasters were already in PRECACHE_URLS from .356/.357/.358, so refs and precache membership are consistent in this commit with no sw.js list change needed. SCRIM (spec 3): overridden to the locked token rgba(2,4,7,.72) -> transparent at 55%, NOT the mock's rgba(4,6,10,...). The scrim is a CSS overlay and is never baked into art. LABEL ZONE (spec 6): .btxt clamps to the left 45%; the mock ran it to 74%, which puts text over subject mass on every row. OPS GEOMETRY (spec 4 ruling): the collapsed OPS head is a .bnr at the SAME aspect-ratio 2.90 as the other four rows. The mock's fixed height:96px .opshead (a 3.771:1 box) was the defect - phantom-banner-ops-1170.webp as shipped in .356 is correct and was NOT re-cut. NO FABRICATED STATE (spec 8): the mock's .f2chip status pills ('3 staged', 'idle', 'last: 06:40', 'synced') and its entire 10-monitor SAMPLE_STATE readout console are DROPPED. Not one SAMPLE_STATE literal reaches dct-ios.html - grep-verified for 148/212, 96/71, 1204, PH7M-2417/18/19, 412, 37 and 62%. NAV GEOMETRY DOES NOT TRAVEL: the mock is standalone at a 64px nav / 100px page pad; live footprint is var(--rd-navclear) and body.rd .page already pays it, so no bottom padding is re-declared. DELIBERATE CALLS made rather than stopping to ask, all reversible in one commit: (1) NINE wall cells per the owner's directive, not the spec-5 TEN - DEPLOY has its own banner row, so a 'deploy' wall cell would be a second door at the same screen; only 'optics' was added to the DEPLOY_TOOLS registry, and only for its back-header title lookup (nothing iterates that registry since .179, so it paints no new card). (2) The 3x3 wall cells are TOOL CELLS - dot, name, meta - with NO live-data readouts. Spec 8's 'every wall cell reads phantomMaster at render time' presupposes the mock's readout console, which is dropped wholesale for carrying fabricated state; binding nine distinct Master accessors is a materially larger surface than this ship's scope and is deferred to a later ship. Zero fabrication either way. (3) Off-map OPS wall colours mapped per spec 6 - portmap #30d158 green to --teal #1fffd0, audits #ff8a00 amber to --gold #ffcb45, bom #2892ff blue to --cyan #28e0ff - and blast #ff453a red to --mag #ff2bd6, the fault channel, since the channel map forbids red/green and spec 6's token set has no red. sops takes the live app's #28e0ff rather than the mock's #8a4bff to avoid two adjacent violet cells. (4) Accents are LITERAL HEX exactly like the .rf-card grid they replace: :root defines --cyan as #5cf2ff and --gold as #ffd60a, NOT the Design-Law-5 #28e0ff/#ffcb45 the mock's own :root used - the mock-token trap that killed the .279 Ask border. (5) The four now-orphaned tile icons (action-deploy-upload, action-scan-radar, action-handoff-link, tool-masterdoc) and their PRECACHE_URLS entries are RETAINED, not deleted: the owner's scope for this commit lists six items and deletion is not among them, and the repo precedent is orphaned-but-retained (the old assistant raster). Folds into the same cleanup ship as the 16 pre-existing dead precache entries. FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED (spec 12): the .subtab-strip at ~13217 (Deploy/Scan/Handoff/Issues) now duplicates three banner rows. Deliberately left alone in this ship - it needs its own ruling. SHARED CSS SURVIVES: .rf-card, .rf-cnr, .rf-i-img, .rf-cic, .rf-glabel and .rf-grid-wrap are all untouched - the TOOLS grid at ~13259 and the platform picker at ~20015 still use them, and .rf-cnr is reused by the banner rows. LEGACY: #work-grid is display:none outside body.rd (:8740) and every new selector is body.rd-scoped or lives inside it, so ?legacy=1 cannot paint any of this - byte-identical. GATES: node --check x3 on the inline script blocks, CSS brace balance, CRLF preserved, three-stamp lockstep. DEVICE-VERIFY, and item 7 is the real gate: (1) stamp reads v1.14.359. (2) BUILD shows FIVE full-width rows; SCAN, MASTER FILE and OPS carry photographs, DEPLOY and HANDOFF show the accent-hatch fallback. (3) EVERY row taps through and every one of the nine wall cells opens its tool - nothing dead. (4) OPS expands in place at 2.90 geometry, not a 96px strip. (5) No label text crosses 45%. (6) No SAMPLE_STATE values anywhere. (7) CLEAR THE SERVICE WORKER, airplane mode, hard reload - the app must boot fully offline. An online eyeball check does not exercise this and does not count. (8) ?legacy=1 unchanged. ROLLBACK is coarse by owner acceptance: revert this one commit and the 12-tile grid, its handlers and the whole banner port come back together.
